content: नील {%a.%} (-ला, -ली {%f.%}; the former in relation to clothes <ab>&c.</ab>, the latter in relation to animals, plants <ab>&c.</ab>) .²1 Blue, dark-blue; नीलस्निग्धः श्रयति शिखरं नूतनस्तोयवाहः <ls>U. 1. 33</ls>. .²2 Dyed with indigo. .{@-लः@} .²1 The dark-blue or black colour. .²2 Sapphire. .²3 The Indian fig-tree. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a monkey-chief in the army of Rāma. .²5 ‘The blue mountain’, <ab>N.</ab> of one of the principal ranges of mountains. .²6 A kind of bird, the blue Mainā. .²7 An ox of a dark-blue colour. .²8 One of the nine treasures of Kubera; see नवनिधि. .²9 A mark. .²10 An auspicious sound or proclamation. .{@-ला@} .²1 The indigo plant. .²2 A Rāgiṇī. .{@-ले@} {%f.%} (<ab>du.</ab>) .²1 The two arteries in front of the neck. .²2 A black and blue mark on the skin; (for other senses see नीली.) .{@-लम्@} .²1 Black-salt. .²2 Blue vitriol. .²3 Antimony. .²4 Poison. .²5 Indigo, indigo dye. .²6 Darkness.
